description: HR-23 is the designated RTO code for the Tohana sub-division in Fatehabad district, Haryana. It functions as a Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the region.
address: SDM Office, Tohana, District Fatehabad, Haryana
